mapper.select: SELECT m.Match_num AS matchNum, TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS matchDate, m.match_time AS matchTime, m.home_score AS homeScore, m.away_score AS awayScore, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName, hc.club_name AS homeClubName, ac.club_name AS awayClubName FROM Match m INNER JOIN Match_Apply ma ON m.apply_id = ma.apply_id INNER JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id INNER JOIN Club hc ON ma.clubOwner_key = hc.clubOwner_key INNER JOIN Club ac ON ma.clubOwner_key2 = ac.clubOwner_key WHERE (ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} OR ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwnerKey}) ORDER BY m.match_date DESC

SELECT m.Match_num AS matchNum, TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS matchDate, m.match_time AS matchTime, m.home_score AS homeScore, m.away_score AS awayScore, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName, hc.club_name AS homeClubName, ac.club_name AS awayClubName FROM Match m INNER JOIN Match_Apply ma ON m.apply_id = ma.apply_id INNER JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id INNER JOIN Club hc ON ma.clubOwner_key = hc.clubOwner_key INNER JOIN Club ac ON ma.clubOwner_key2 = ac.clubOwner_key
(ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} OR ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwnerKey})
AND TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY') = #{year}
AND TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'MM') = #{month}
AND ((ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} AND m.home_score > m.away_score) OR (ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwnerKey} AND m.away_score > m.home_score))
AND m.home_score = m.away_score
AND ((ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} AND m.home_score < m.away_score) OR (ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwnerKey} AND m.away_score < m.home_score))
ORDER BY m.match_date DESC

SELECT m.Match_num AS matchNum, m.match_date AS matchDate, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName, hc.club_name AS homeClubName, m.home_score AS homeScore, ac.club_name AS awayClubName, ac.club_logo AS awayClubLogo, m.away_score AS awayScore FROM Match m JOIN Match_Apply ma ON m.apply_id = ma.apply_id JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id JOIN Club hc ON ma.clubOwner_key = hc.clubOwner_key JOIN Club ac ON ma.clubOwner_key2 = ac.clubOwner_key WHERE (ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} OR ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwnerKey}) AND ma.status = 1 ORDER BY m.match_date DESC
mapper.delete: UPDATE Match SET home_score = NULL, away_score = NULL WHERE match_num = #{matchNum}
